headline: Ingersoll Rand India files structural digital database certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing submitted by Ingersoll Rand
summary: Ingersoll Rand (India) Limited has submitted its Structural Digital Database (SDD) compliance certificate for the quarter ending September 2026. This regulatory filing adheres to SEBI insider trading regulations regarding unpublished price-sensitive information. For an Indian retail investor, this is standard corporate governance housekeeping with no direct impact on stock price or earnings.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: Ingersoll Rand issues corrigendum to postal ballot notice
summary: Ingersoll Rand (India) Limited has issued a corrigendum regarding the notice of its postal ballot dated August 14, 2026. The company submitted this routine disclosure to the stock exchange. Such corrections typically involve minor typographical or procedural updates to ongoing shareholder voting items. Indian retail shareholders participating in the postal ballot should review the updated notice.
why_it_matters: Review updated ballot details before voting.
